FIRE PARTICLE DUNGEON
불의 원소 던전

WATER PARTICLE DUNGEON
불의 원소 던전

● Deals MDMG and grants [MAX HP Boost]
● Heals self upon using 3-MAN AOE

EARTH PARTICLE DUNGEON
땅의 원소 던전

● Deals PDMG and grants [DEF Boost]
● DMG multipliers scale partially off DEF as well

LIGHT PARTICLE DUNGEON
빛의 원소 던전

● Deals MDMG and grants [DMG Nullification]
● Can also grant self [MATK Boost] on skill

DARK PARTICLE DUNGEON
암흑의 원소 던전

● Deals PDMG and grants [PATK Boost], [DEF Boost] & [MAX HP Boost]
● Inflicts [DEF Reduction] so Debuff Removal is highly important
● After 5 basic attacks, it deals 99,999 Fixed Piercing DMG to your team 3 time(s) and reduces Buff Duration by 3 turns
